content.rendered:
Private cold plunge and ice bath in Dubai

Looking for an ice bath in Dubai without the crowds? Beit Sisu’s cold plunges are completely private. Book a cold plunge room on its own, or combine it with an infrared sauna in one of our contrast therapy suites in Dubai Media City.

How cold is it?

Our plunges are kept between 3.5 and 8°C. The water is cleaned around the clock: ozone is injected during filtration 24/7, and we treat it daily with spa-grade, non-toxic sanitisers.

Your first cold plunge

Don’t worry – there are no heroes here. Start with 30 seconds to a minute and build up over your visits. If you have any pre-existing medical conditions, please check with your doctor first. Shivering afterwards is normal; let your body warm up naturally, or take a room-temperature shower.

Sessions

Cold plunge room bookings are 15 or 30 minutes, which gives you time to shower before and after. Showering before your plunge is required, and we provide a towel. Bringing a friend? The room has a one-person barrel so you can take turns (30-minute sessions only).

Why cold?

  • Mood and focus – cold water triggers a big release of dopamine and norepinephrine, the brain’s natural energy and focus boosters.
  • Recovery – cold immersion helps soothe sore, tired muscles.
  • Stress resilience – short, controlled exposure to cold trains your body to stay calm under stress.
  • Sleep – a morning plunge helps set your body clock for the day.

Prices

  • 1 person: AED 85 (15 min) · AED 120 (30 min)
  • 2 people: AED 160 (30 min)
  • Or book contrast therapy (sauna + plunge + red light) from AED 160

Want an ice bath at home or at your event? See our portable ice bath rental.

content.rendered:
Private infrared sauna in Dubai Media City

At Beit Sisu you never share a sauna with strangers. Each of our contrast therapy suites at the Arjaan by Rotana Hotel in Dubai Media City has its own full-spectrum infrared sauna, a cold plunge, a red light therapy tower and a private shower – all yours for the whole session.

What a session looks like

Our infrared saunas run between 50 and 79°C. That’s gentler than a traditional sauna, because infrared warms your body directly rather than heating the air around you. We keep each sauna at its maximum temperature during the day, but just ask if you’d prefer it lower – the benefits still come at any temperature. Sessions are 30 or 60 minutes (if the room is free, you can extend to 90 minutes at the studio), and the sauna fits two people if you’d like to bring a friend.

Most guests combine heat and cold: about 10 minutes in the sauna, 30 seconds to a minute in the plunge, and repeat 3–4 times in an hour.

Why people come back

  • Relaxation and better sleep – a session helps your body switch into its “rest” mode, and many guests sleep noticeably better afterwards.
  • Muscle recovery – heat increases blood flow to tired muscles and helps ease inflammation.
  • Skin – sweating boosts circulation and leaves skin looking clearer and brighter.
  • Stress relief – a quiet, private space to switch off from the city.

What to bring

Just a swimsuit and water. We provide a towel, Gymskin shower products and filtered water, and you can watch Netflix or play music through the Bluetooth speaker.

Prices

All sessions include the infrared sauna, cold plunge and red light therapy.

  • 1 person: AED 160 (30 min) · AED 220 (60 min)
  • 2 people: AED 200 (30 min) · AED 260 (60 min)
  • First visit? The Intro Offer gives you 3 × 60-minute sessions for AED 350

content.rendered:
Red light therapy in Dubai Media City

Every Beit Sisu contrast therapy suite includes a red light therapy tower, so you can add it to your sauna and cold plunge session at no extra cost.

What is red light therapy?

Red light therapy uses panels of red and near-infrared light that work at the level of your cells to support healing and recovery in skin, hair and muscles. It’s different from an infrared sauna, which uses heat to raise your body temperature and make you sweat – using both in one session gives you the benefits of each.

What people use it for

  • Skin – softening fine lines, calming breakouts and helping scars heal.
  • Recovery and pain relief – easing muscle soreness after training.
  • Mood – many guests find it lifts their mood and helps them relax.

How to use it in your session

Stand or sit facing the tower whenever you like during your session – between sauna rounds works well. There’s nothing to prepare and nothing to wear except your swimsuit.

Prices

Included in every contrast therapy session: 1 person from AED 160, 2 people from AED 200, or the Intro Offer (3 × 60 min) for AED 350.
